profile.summary: The Center for Educational Partnerships is a University of California, Berkeley program, founded in 1984, that works to increase access to higher education. It provides outreach to students from kindergarten through community college, their families and educators. Its ten programs offer direct services to students, professional development for educators, and work with school districts and colleges.
